出生地: 美国,加利福尼亚州,伯班克
简介: Ashley discovered acting at an early age, having grown up in the film industry. At the age of 1 1/2, she had her first on-screen appearance on Miami Vice as the adopted daughter of Stanley Tucci.Ashley graduated from the prestigious Los Angeles County High School for the Arts, and attended DePaul University in Chicago, Illinois, both for Theater.She currently resides in Los Angeles, California.
